subject: Upcoming Event: Annual Company Conference
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce the date for our annual company conference! Mark your calendars for Friday, October 15th, 2021. This year's event will be held at the Grand Hotel and will feature keynote speakers, breakout sessions, and team-building activities. Stay tuned for more details and the official agenda. Save the date and get ready for a day of inspiration, learning, and networking. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Your Name]
